name: Gasthof Feldwebel
beschreibung:
Centrally located in picturesque Soell, the historic Gasthof Feldwebel welcomes guests with stylish rooms, attentive service, and renowned regional culinary craft.

The Soell cable car accessing SkiWelt and surrounding mountain paths are just an easy walk away.
kurzbeschreibung: The historic Gasthof Feldwebel in Soell brings together centuries of tradition, fine cuisine, and modern comfort.
